name: Knight
notes: CR 3. Plate AC 18. HP 52. Multiattack ×2. Longsword +5 (1d8+3, 1d10+3 versatile). Heavy crossbow +2 (1d10, 100/400 ft). Brave: adv on saves vs Frightened. Leadership (recharge 5-6): creatures within 30 ft add d4 to attack/save until end of Knight's next turn.
gm_notes: Session 3 river crossing — pursuit centurion leading 8 legionaries (Guard stat blocks). Lawful, not evil. Does not want this fight. Intimidation DC 14 (centurion-rank character): hesitates, long enough for party to cross. On 5 above: signals men to hold. Varro (if present) can speak one sentence that makes it land or fall apart. He has families and years of service ahead of him — the moral weight is intentional.
